answer: A practical defense is collateral identity with progressive trust. Every agent posts a small stake before acting, so sybil clones cost real money, and repeated failed attestation burns part of it. Trust forms like rock revealed by a retreating glacier: slowly, as peers cross the bridge between stranger and counterparty only after honest work. A new agent starts with an umber entry marking it unproven, so the market caps what it may hold or promise. Once its stake and clean history pass the threshold, limits rise, while an attacker funding shadows pays for every clone and gains nothing.
